```{python}
#| include: false
import csv

with open("data/attractions.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

for r in rows:
    r["visits"] = int(r["visits_2025"])
    r["name"] = r["attraction"].split(" (")[0].removeprefix("The ")

top = max(rows, key=lambda r: r["visits"])
total = sum(r["visits"] for r in rows)
n_free = sum(r["admission"].startswith("Free") for r in rows)
top3 = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r["visits"], reverse=True)[:3]
top3_names = ", ".join(r["name"] for r in top3[:-1]) + " and " + top3[-1]["name"]
top3_total = sum(r["visits"] for r in top3)
```

## Why London

London's biggest attractions drew **`{python} f"{total:,}"` visits in 2025**, counting only the ten most-visited London members of the Association of Leading Visitor Attractions (ALVA).

- The most visited was the `{python} top["name"]`, with `{python} f"{top['visits']:,}"` visits.
- The top three, `{python} top3_names`, accounted for `{python} f"{top3_total:,}"` visits between them.
- `{python} str(n_free)` of the ten are free to enter, although some charge for special exhibitions.

These figures cover ALVA members only, so they are not every sight in London.

## Five sights

| Sight | Area | Price band | Nearest tube | Official site |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| British Museum | Bloomsbury | Free (special exhibitions extra) | Tottenham Court Road | [britishmuseum.org](https://www.britishmuseum.org) |
| Natural History Museum | South Kensington | Free (special exhibitions extra) | South Kensington | [nhm.ac.uk](https://www.nhm.ac.uk) |
| Tate Modern | Bankside | Free (special exhibitions extra) | Blackfriars | [tate.org.uk](https://www.tate.org.uk/visit/tate-modern) |
| National Gallery | Trafalgar Square | Free (special exhibitions extra) | Charing Cross | [nationalgallery.org.uk](https://www.nationalgallery.org.uk) |
| Tower of London | Tower Hill | Paid ticket | Tower Hill | [hrp.org.uk](https://www.hrp.org.uk/tower-of-london/) |

## Getting around

- **Tube:** each sight in the table lists its nearest station.
- **Bus:** runs alongside the Tube across the city.
- **Santander Cycles:** London's bike hire scheme.

Visitors can pay for the Tube and buses with a contactless card or an Oyster card. The [TfL Journey Planner](https://tfl.gov.uk/plan-a-journey/) maps each day's route by Tube, bus or bike.
